notes:
Alpha

• A refreshed interface with Dark and Midnight themes, brighter collection artwork and multiple UI upgrades.
• Save named markers and loop a passage from Track tools, the waveform button beside the player. Drag to select a section, use a 5-, 10-, or 30-second quick loop, or loop between markers.
• Smart playlists can now filter by duration, date added, and last played, including rolling day windows. Older tracks keep an unknown date added; use “is empty” to include unknown dates.
• Find preferences in tabbed Settings, and get started with a skippable first-launch setup that explains stacks and playlists.
